items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m interviewing for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College, in Woodstock. And I’m happy to have Burrill Crohn with me...

ctx.x: Burrill was interviewed on January 3, 2012 in Woodstock, NY, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m interviewing for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College, in Woodstock. And I’m happy to have Burrill Crohn with me, who is usually on the other side of the camera.
I could still do it if you want.
